metadata.title: Audit trail (commit trailer + AWS-call instrumentation + DDB session record + audit endpoint)

story.iWant: every action the free-agent takes — commits, AWS API calls, DDB writes — to be traceable back to a specific session, operator, and timestamp
story.soThat: if anything anomalous happens I can answer "what did the agent do?" in under 5 minutes via standard queries, not a forensic archaeology dig
story.tasks:
Daemon — commit-msg hook: - Create daemon/pipelines/lib/free-agent-commit-msg-hook.sh — reads commit-msg file path ($1), checks if `Agent: FREE-AGENT-${FREE_AGENT_SESSION_ID}` already present, appends if not. Idempotent. (AC #1, AC #2) - Extend daemon/pipelines/lib/free-agent-worktree.mjs — add installCommitMsgHook({worktreePath, sessionId, hookScriptPath}). Writes script to <worktreePath>/.git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg with mode 0755. Idempotent: if existing hook present, append marker-bracketed block; don't overwrite. (AC #1, AC #2) - Extend daemon/pipelines/free-agent-session.mjs — pass FREE_AGENT_SESSION_ID=<sessionId> in spawn env. (AC #1) - Create daemon/pipelines/__tests__/free-agent-commit-msg-hook.test.mjs — execFile-based: appends trailer to clean message; no-op on already-tagged message; coexists with other agents' trailers. (AC #7) - Extend daemon/pipelines/__tests__/free-agent-worktree.test.mjs — hook installation tests (path, mode, idempotent re-install). (AC #7)
Shared — token accumulation: - Extend functions/shared/types/free-agent.ts — add tokensInAccumulated + tokensOutAccumulated to FreeAgentSession. (AC #3) - Extend functions/shared/repositories/free-agent-sessions-repository.ts — add updateTokens(sessionId, tokensIn, tokensOut) using atomic ADD expression. (AC #3) - Extend functions/shared/repositories/__tests__/free-agent-sessions-repository.test.ts — ADD expression + no-op on zero/negative. (AC #7)
Daemon — usage capture + AWS-call instrumentation: - Extend daemon/pipelines/free-agent-session.mjs — parse usage.{input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens} from stream-json result event; call sessionsRepo.updateTokens. (AC #3) - Extend agent-daemon.mjs facade — add freeAgentUpdateTokens; wire into buildFreeAgentSessionsRepoFacade. (AC #3) - Extend daemon/pipelines/free-agent-session.mjs — structure subprocess stderr forwarding so AWS-SDK errors include the sessionId tag in the emit event. (AC #4) - Extend daemon/pipelines/__tests__/free-agent-session.test.mjs — updateTokens called with parsed usage. (AC #7)
API — audit endpoint: - Add GET /api/free-agent/sessions/:id/audit to functions/api/index.ts. Validate :id. Load session (404 if absent). Authorize: caller sub === session.operatorId OR admin scope. Query agent-events with jobId=sessionId. Build response { sessionId, session, events: [{timestamp, kind, detail}] }. (AC #5, AC #6) - Create functions/api/__tests__/free-agent-audit-route.test.ts — happy path + 403 + 404 + 400. (AC #7)
Validation: - npm run ci end-to-end. (AC #9)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC #1 — prepare-commit-msg hook installed by daemon at <worktreePath>/.git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg, adds `Agent: FREE-AGENT-<sessionId>` trailer via $FREE_AGENT_SESSION_ID env var injected at spawn time. AC #2 — Hook + install both idempotent. Hook: no-op on already-tagged message. Install: marker-bracketed append if existing hook present. AC #3 — updateTokens repo function + sessionsRepo facade extension + handler usage-parse + atomic ADD on tokensInAccumulated/tokensOutAccumulated. AC #4 — Subprocess stderr forwarded with sessionId tagging. CloudTrail metric filter deferred to v1.1 (non-trivial without real deploy). AC #5 — GET /api/free-agent/sessions/:id/audit returns { sessionId, session, events: [{timestamp, kind, detail}] } — events from agent-events filtered by sessionId. AC #6 — Auth-gated: owner OR admin. 403 otherwise. (Admin scope check defaults to owner-only if no clean pattern exists in api/index.ts; admin escalation is a one-line follow-up.) AC #7 — Unit tests pass: free-agent-commit-msg-hook.test.mjs (NEW), free-agent-worktree.test.mjs (EXTENDED), free-agent-session.test.mjs (EXTENDED), free-agent-sessions-repository.test.ts (EXTENDED), free-agent-audit-route.test.ts (NEW). AC #8 — Manual EC2 verification (deferred to operator post-deploy). AC #9 — npm run ci passes with no new regressions beyond pre-existing baseline.

git.component: Git's standard hook contract. Receives commit-msg file path as $1; can read/modify it. Exits 0 on success.

story-context.constraints: - Hook install is best-effort additive — never overwrite an existing prepare-commit-msg hook. If present, append our marker-bracketed block: `# >>> futurator free-agent commit-msg trailer >>>` ... `# <<< futurator free-agent commit-msg trailer <<<` so re-install detects and skips. - FREE_AGENT_SESSION_ID env var is the contract between daemon spawn and hook script. Default to 'unknown' inside the hook if unset. - CloudTrail metric filter is deferred to v1.1. Daemon-side stderr tagging is the v1 substitute. - Admin scope check: if no clean pattern exists in functions/api/index.ts today, default audit endpoint to owner-only. Wire admin escalation as a one-line follow-up. [Source: memory feedback_ship_mvp_add_later] - Usage parsing: verify the exact shape (input_tokens vs cache_creation_input_tokens, etc.) on real EC2 result events. Parser should be defensive against missing fields. - All zod validation via .safeParse() only. [Source: CLAUDE.md Validation] - npm run ci must pass with no new regressions beyond pre-existing baseline (4 epic-dev-pipeline failures + Plan.kind/TimerCategory typecheck + knip warnings + 4 pre-existing agent-daemon.mjs lint warnings). [Source: Story 18.2 CI summary] - Production-only SST deploy guard: any infra changes only land on production deploys. This story adds no new SST resources, so no concern.

interface.name: installCommitMsgHook (NEW)
interface.signature:
installCommitMsgHook({ worktreePath: string, sessionId: string, hookScriptPath?: string, // default = FREE_AGENT_COMMIT_MSG_HOOK_SCRIPT fs?: { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, chmodSync } }): void
Behavior: - If <worktreePath>/.git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg does NOT exist: write our hook script verbatim with mode 0o755. - If it exists AND contains our marker `# >>> futurator free-agent commit-msg trailer >>>`: no-op (idempotent re-install). - If it exists WITHOUT our marker: append our marker-bracketed block calling out to our script. Preserves existing hook logic. - Idempotent.

interface.name: free-agent-commit-msg-hook.sh (NEW)
interface.signature: #!/usr/bin/env bash # Args: $1 — commit-msg file path # Env: FREE_AGENT_SESSION_ID (defaults to 'unknown') # Behavior: if `Agent: FREE-AGENT-${FREE_AGENT_SESSION_ID}` not in the file, append it as a trailer (separated by a blank line if needed). Idempotent. # Exit: 0 always (do not block the commit on hook errors).
